annotations.title: Find a paint color by name or number

description: Look up a specific paint color by name or color number (e.g. 'Agreeable Gray', 'SW 7029', 'HC-154', 'Hale Navy Benjamin Moore') and get its brand, color number, hex and availability (current, retired or discontinued). Use it to get the hex of a named paint color before calling match_paint_color, or to check that a color name or number exists. Searches 26,000+ colors across 13 brands; call list_brands for the brand slugs.

brand.description: Optional. Restrict the search to one brand slug from list_brands, e.g. 'behr'.

limit.description: Optional. Number of colors to return (1–10). Default 5.

query.description: Color name, color number, or both, optionally with the brand name (e.g. 'Agreeable Gray', 'SW 7029', 'Repose Gray sherwin williams').

name: find_paint_color
